ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution; high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to localized scars and distal tips, representing <5% of the total visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-gray to black field across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white circular ring formations (approx. 8-12 units) are distributed across the mid-ventral regions. Irregular high-intensity textured clusters are mapped to the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 48 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; frequency of approx. 15 peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 18 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge, transitioning into a steep upward and outward curvature at the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clear detection of circular white ring-scars. Left lobe contains a vertically-aligned triad of rings; right lobe contains a non-linear cluster of four distinct rings.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, low-contrast white linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, appearing as horizontal scratches roughly 20-40 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; numerous circular 'cookie-cutter' style scars distributed across the central area of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water surface turbulence and high-intensity foam occlusion at the insertion point of the fluke into the waterline.
